SECRET
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S.1, Special Branch
REPORT
File No. __________
No. S. B. D. 7937
Date June 1, 1937.
Subject The "Kih Kwang" (Sun Rays) Weekly Magazine (日光週刊).
Made by C.D.I. Sih Tse-liang. Forwarded by J. Boyce D.S.I.

With reference to the attached report, I have to state
that there are two houses on Robison Road which bear the
number "210". The number plate of one of the two houses is
issued by the Chinese authorities and the other, by the
S.M.C. Both of them are situated outside the Settlement.
Diligent enquiries have been made by detectives of this
office but nothing was learned that would indicate that there
is an organization known as the "Jih Cheh Cultural Society"
or any other body which may likely be mistaken for the above
society in existence, or making use of either of the two
houses.
The house which bears the number plate issued by the
Chinese authorities is one of the houses of the block called
Tsing Yuen Li (富源里), west of Kiaochow Road. It was
formerly leased to the Boh Dah Dried Goods Shop which closed
down in 1935 owing to business depression. Ever since that
time it has not been let. At present the wife of the gateman
of Tsing Yuen Li, named Oong Tsung Zeu, occupies an upstairs
room of the house. The woman is 55 years of age.
The other house on Robison Road which bears the number
plate (210) issued by the S.M.C. also bears a number plate
(NO.89) issued by the Chinese authorities. It is situated
near Penang Road and is occupied by Ao Shiu Zung (夏秀成),
a native of Kiangyin, and Chiang Shung Tsao, a native of
Kiangsu, both of whom are working in the Japan China Cotton
Mill.
Enquiries made in the vicinity of both houses as well
as amongst workers of the Japan-China Cotton Mill failed to
show that the occupants of either house have any connection

S.1，特别股
报告
档案号 ___
编号 S. B. D. 7937
日期 1937年6月1日。
事由 《日光週刊》（Sun Rays）周刊。
由 华探员 施子良 呈报。经 副华探长 J. Boyce 转呈。

关于所附报告，本人须说明，罗宾森路（Robison Road）上有两栋门牌号为“210”的房屋。其中一栋的门牌由中国当局颁发，另一栋由工部局（S.M.C.）颁发。这两栋房屋均位于租界之外。本署侦探已进行详尽查访，但未发现任何迹象表明存在名为“日社文化协会”（Jih Cheh Cultural Society）的组织，或任何其他可能被误认为上述社团的团体在使用这两栋房屋中的任何一栋。

挂有中国当局颁发门牌的房屋是胶州路以西富源里（Tsing Yuen Li）街区中的一栋。该房屋此前租给博大百货店，该店因生意萧条于1935年停业。自那时起，该房屋一直未出租。目前，富源里看门人翁宗周（Oong Tsung Zeu，音译）的妻子居住在该房屋的楼上房间。该妇女现年55岁。

罗宾森路上另一栋挂有工部局颁发门牌（210号）的房屋，同时也挂有中国当局颁发的门牌（89号）。该房屋位于槟榔路（Penang Road）附近，由江阴籍人士夏秀成（Ao Shiu Zung）和江苏籍人士蒋松藻（Chiang Shung Tsao，音译）居住，二人均在日华纱厂工作。

CONFIDENTIAL
May 10, 1937.
7937
3 6 3

Formation of "Jih Cheh" (日出) (Sun Rising)
Cultural Society by members of the Socialist
Democratic Clique.
----------

According to information Mr. Wang Tu-tsing
(王独清), a member of the Socialist Democratic
Clique, has recently established at No.210 Robison
Road a body known as the "Jih Cheh" Cultural Society
and has published a magazine known as the "Kih Kwang"
(Sun Rays) Weekly Magazine (日光週刊) the contents
of which criticise the Government's attitude of compromise
towards Japan.

社会民主党派成员组建“日社”（日出）
（Sun Rising）文化协会。
---

据情报显示，社会民主党派成员王独清
(王独清) 最近在罗宾森路210号成立了一个名为“日社”文化协会的团体，并出版了一本名为《日光》（Sun Rays）周刊（日光週刊）的杂志，其内容批评政府对日妥协的态度。
